premise: A high platform feels safe from something under the water until the creature begins removing the supports.
cast: Marin: saved navy cap/yellow vest, white round head/white hands/feet, thin black limbs.
Oren: adult mechanic, orange hard hat and grey work vest; same white-head stick style, no hair/ears.
Bea: adult cook, burgundy work apron over dark simple clothing; white head/hands/feet.
Leviathan: canonical teal body and pale-yellow eye.
Giant shark: separate canonical grey creature, never recoloured leviathan.
locations: Top helipad -> galley/bunks -> machinery bay floor hatch/service ladder -> lower cage.
Damaged direct walkway/short frame -> launch berth.
Old east pipe-rack route initially physically blocked; structural shift clears entrance.
Bent gate -> berth; generator western post opposite east escape route.
Launch passes rig legs -> coastal inlet ramp -> inspected maintenance shed.
chronology: Days1-6: supply boat lost, systems shut down, launch observed, blocked east route and generator tested.
Days7-11: steel-impact observation, fuel cage run, direct route fails, crane proposed.
Days12-17: storm destroys crane/cage; lone inspection fuels launch; short frame then fails.
Days18-23: structural tilt opens east route, gate/wrench attempt fails.
Days24-28: wrench lost, generator repositioned, route prepared, support breaks.
Late day29: generator distraction and launch; day30 inlet landing and shelter.
setups_and_payoffs: Boat exists from day1; routes/crossing and fuel solved before departure.
Repeated steel impacts tested twice pay off in generator diversion.
Oren abandons crane fixation and cooperates with Bea; rig collapse fulfills escalating threat.
persistent_states: No main pumps continuing while platform becomes quiet; generator is a separate portable unit.
Fuel moved before lower cage loss; generator reserve separate; launch explicitly fuelled.
Crane remains unusable, cage lost, direct walkway and short frame remain broken.
East route not ignored because long: blocking rack cleared by observed structural shift.
Wrench dropped into sea and never retrieved.
Generator moves west, stays until collapse; launch key physically recovered.
Food bin transferred aboard; no new coast rescue.
visual_reference_status: Use existing preset main/drawing guide; prepare and inspect recurring side-character and new-location references before scenes.
